dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast dark perimeters transitioning to lighter speckled interiors. The largest central annuli feature sharp outer boundaries and irregular, slightly elongated circular geometries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-intensity dark blobs are scattered with moderate density, particularly concentrated in the interstices between major annuli. Core pixel concentration is highest in small, circular nodes lacking internal gradients along the lower-right transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the upper-mid region form an irregular quadrilateral, characterized by two acute angles at the uppermost points relative to the frame and a wider base towards the lower-right quadrant.
